question: How do I record a video for my baby?
answer: To record a video, open the app and go to the Video Recording section. Follow the step-by-step instructions shown on your screen. Make sure your baby is calm and still before you start recording. The app will guide you through each step to make sure the video is good quality.

question: What should my baby be wearing during the video?
answer: Your baby should be wearing light, comfortable clothing that allows the whole body to be clearly visible. Avoid thick blankets or clothing that covers the arms and legs. The assessor needs to see your baby's full body clearly in the video.

question: How long does the video need to be?
answer: The video must be long enough for the assessor to properly observe your baby's movements. The app will tell you if the video is too short. Generally, aim for at least 2 to 3 minutes of recording. A progress indicator in the app will show you when you have recorded enough.

question: My baby is crying. Can I still record?
answer: It is best to wait until your baby is calm before recording. A calm baby allows the assessor to properly observe natural movements. Try feeding, soothing, or letting your baby rest before attempting the recording again.

question: The app said my video is not good quality. What should I do?
answer: If the app says your video is not good quality, you can record it again. Common reasons for poor quality include the baby being unsettled, clothing covering the body, poor lighting, or the video being too short. Check each of these things and try recording again.

question: Does the whole body need to be visible in the video?
answer: Yes, the baby's whole body must be visible throughout the video. Make sure the camera is positioned so that you can see your baby from head to toe. Do not zoom in too much on one part of the body.

question: What lighting is best for recording?
answer: Record in a well-lit room with natural or bright indoor light. Avoid recording in dim rooms or with a strong light source directly behind your baby, as this creates shadows. Good lighting helps the assessor clearly see your baby's movements.

question: Can I use a tablet to record the video?
answer: Yes, you can use a tablet or a smartphone to record the video. Make sure the camera is clean and the device is held steady. You can also prop the device on a stable surface to avoid shaking during recording.

question: Should the baby be lying down or sitting during the video?
answer: Follow the specific instructions shown in the app for your baby's age and assessment type. Generally, young babies are recorded lying on a flat, firm surface. The app will show you the correct position for your baby.

question: Can someone else hold the camera while I comfort my baby?
answer: Yes, another caregiver or family member can hold the camera while you are near your baby. Make sure the person recording keeps the camera steady and keeps the baby's whole body in frame at all times.

question: How do I upload a video?
answer: After recording, the app will give you the option to upload the video. Tap the Upload button and the video will be sent to the system automatically. You will see a progress bar showing how much of the video has been uploaded.

question: My internet is slow. Can I still upload?
answer: Yes. The system is designed to work with slow internet connections. The video is uploaded in small parts, so even if your connection is weak, the upload will continue. If it stops, the app will automatically try to restart the upload from where it left off.

question: The upload stopped halfway. What do I do?
answer: Do not worry. The upload can be restarted. Open the app and go to your video timeline. Find the video that was being uploaded and tap Retry Upload. The system will continue uploading from where it stopped, so you do not need to start again from the beginning.

question: How long does the upload take?
answer: Upload time depends on your internet speed and the size of the video. With a good connection, it may take a few minutes. With a slow connection, it may take longer. You can watch the progress bar in the app to see how the upload is going.

question: Can I close the app while the video is uploading?
answer: It is best to keep the app open during the upload. If you close the app, the upload may pause. When you open the app again, the upload should resume automatically from where it stopped.

question: I uploaded the wrong video. Can I replace it?
answer: If the system has asked you to re-record, you can upload a new video to replace the old one. Go to your video timeline, find the video, and select the option to replace it. If the video has already been reviewed, contact your care team for help.

question: Will I get a confirmation when my video is uploaded?
answer: Yes. Once the video is fully uploaded, you will receive a notification. The status of the video in your timeline will also change to Submitted. You can check this at any time in the app.

question: What file format does the video need to be in?
answer: The app handles the video format automatically when you record using the in-app camera. If you are uploading a video recorded outside the app, the most common formats such as MP4 are supported. The app will let you know if there is a problem with the format.

question: Can I upload more than one video?
answer: Yes. You can upload multiple videos over time as requested by your care team. Each video will appear in your baby's timeline with its own status. You can track all videos from the timeline screen.

question: My upload keeps failing. What should I do?
answer: First, check your internet connection. Try moving closer to your Wi-Fi router or switching to mobile data. If the problem continues, close and reopen the app and try again. If it still fails, contact support through the Help section of the app.

question: What does Draft status mean?
answer: Draft means you have started a video but have not submitted it yet. You can finish recording and submit it when you are ready. Draft videos are only visible to you and have not been sent to the assessor.

question: What does Submitted status mean?
answer: Submitted means your video has been successfully uploaded and sent to the assessment team. It is waiting to be reviewed. You do not need to do anything at this stage.

question: What does Re-record Needed mean?
answer: Re-record Needed means the assessor was not able to use your video. This could be because of quality issues such as poor lighting, the baby being unsettled, or the body not being fully visible. You will need to record and upload a new video.

question: What does Under Review mean?
answer: Under Review means an assessor is currently watching and evaluating your baby's video. You will be notified once the review is complete. This process may take some time depending on the assessor's schedule.

question: What does Reviewed mean?
answer: Reviewed means the assessor has finished evaluating your baby's video and has written their findings. You may receive a notification with the outcome and any recommended next steps. Check the app for more details.

question: How do I see the status of my video?
answer: Open the app and go to the Timeline section. All your submitted videos are listed there with their current status shown next to each one. You can tap on any video to see more details.

question: How long does the review take?
answer: Review times can vary depending on the assessor's workload. You will receive a notification when the review is complete. If you have been waiting a long time, you can check the status in your timeline or contact your care team.

question: Will I be told if my video is rejected?
answer: Yes. If your video cannot be used, the status will change to Re-record Needed and you will receive a notification explaining why. You will then be guided to record and submit a new video.

question: Can I see old video statuses?
answer: Yes. Your video timeline keeps a full history of all videos you have submitted. You can scroll through past submissions and see their statuses and any notes that have been shared with you.

question: I submitted a video but the status has not changed. Is that normal?
answer: Yes, it can take some time for the status to update after submission. The system processes uploads in order. If the status has not changed after 24 hours, check your internet connection was stable during upload, or contact support through the app.

question: How do I create a profile for my baby?
answer: Go to the Profiles section in the app and tap Add Baby. You will be asked to enter your baby's name, date of birth, risk group if applicable, and any other relevant notes. Once saved, the profile will be ready to use for video submissions.

question: Can I manage more than one baby on the same account?
answer: Yes. One caregiver account can manage multiple baby profiles. Each baby has their own separate profile, timeline, and video history. You can switch between profiles from the home screen.

question: How do I update my baby's information?
answer: Go to your baby's profile and tap Edit. You can update details such as notes, contact information, and other relevant fields. Make sure to save your changes before leaving the page.

question: What is a risk group?
answer: A risk group is a medical classification used by the assessment team to prioritise and categorise babies based on specific health factors. Your doctor or midwife will tell you if your baby belongs to a particular risk group. You can add this information to the baby's profile.

question: Can I add notes to my baby's profile?
answer: Yes. There is a notes field in the baby profile where you can add any relevant information such as health conditions, feeding habits, or observations. These notes can be seen by authorised assessors and clinicians.

question: How do I add contact information to the profile?
answer: In the baby profile editing screen, there is a section for contact information. You can add your phone number, email, and any other relevant contact details. This helps the care team reach you quickly if needed.

question: Can I delete a baby's profile?
answer: Deleting a profile is a sensitive action as it involves health data. You can submit a data deletion request through the Privacy and Data section of the app. An administrator will review and process your request in line with data retention rules.

question: Is my baby's profile information private?
answer: Yes. Your baby's information is private and is only visible to people you have given access to, such as your assigned assessor or clinician. You can manage who has access at any time from the Consent and Sharing settings.

question: What is the consent process?
answer: Before any of your baby's videos or data are reviewed, the system will ask you to read and agree to the privacy rules. This is the consent process. You must complete this before submitting any videos. It ensures you understand how your data will be used and who can see it.

question: Can I change who has access to my baby's data?
answer: Yes. You can change access permissions at any time from the Consent and Sharing settings. You can grant or remove access for specific doctors or assessors. Changes take effect immediately.

question: Can I take back my consent?
answer: Yes. You can withdraw consent at any time. Go to the Privacy and Data section and select Withdraw Consent. Please note that withdrawing consent may affect the care your baby receives through the platform. The care team will be notified of your decision.

question: Who can see my baby's video?
answer: Only people you have given access to can see your baby's video. This includes your assigned assessor and any clinicians or doctors you have authorised. You can see the full list of people with access in the Consent and Sharing settings.

question: Do I have to give consent before uploading a video?
answer: Yes. The consent process must be completed before any video is submitted or reviewed. The app will guide you through the consent steps the first time you use the platform. You will not be able to submit videos until consent is recorded.

question: What happens to my data if I withdraw consent?
answer: If you withdraw consent, your data will no longer be accessible to the assessment team. You may request deletion of your data separately through the Data Deletion section. The platform will follow data retention rules, which means some records may be kept for legal or audit purposes.

question: Can I give access to my family doctor?
answer: Yes. You can grant access to specific doctors or clinicians by entering their details in the Consent and Sharing settings. Once access is granted, they will be able to view relevant data about your baby.

question: What notifications will I receive?
answer: You will receive notifications for important events such as when your video has been received, when a re-record is requested, when a review is complete, and when a follow-up is due. These will be sent by SMS or email depending on your preferences.

question: How do I change my notification preferences?
answer: Go to the Notification Center in the app settings. From there you can choose whether to receive notifications by SMS, email, or both. You can also turn off specific types of notifications if you do not need them.

question: I am not receiving any notifications. What should I do?
answer: First, check your notification preferences in the app to make sure notifications are turned on. Also check that your email address and phone number in your profile are correct. Check your spam or junk email folder as well. If the problem continues, contact support.

question: Can I receive notifications by both SMS and email?
answer: Yes. You can choose to receive notifications by SMS, email, or both. Go to the Notification Center in settings and select your preferred options.

question: Will I get a notification when the review is done?
answer: Yes. Once an assessor completes the review of your baby's video, you will receive a notification. The notification will tell you the outcome and any next steps. You can also check the status in your video timeline.

question: How do I ask a clinician a question?
answer: Go to the Expert Advice Desk in the app. You can submit a structured question to a verified clinician. You can also link your question to a specific video submission if relevant, and attach supporting files such as a referral note.

question: How long does it take to get a response from a clinician?
answer: Response times vary depending on the clinician's availability. You can track the status of your query in the Expert Advice Desk. The status will show as Open, In Review, Responded, or Closed so you always know where things stand.

question: What is the status Open in Expert Advice?
answer: Open means your query has been submitted and is waiting for a clinician to pick it up and begin reviewing it. No action is needed from you at this stage.

question: What does In Review mean in Expert Advice?
answer: In Review means a clinician has seen your query and is currently reviewing it. They may be looking at your baby's video or other supporting information before responding.

question: What does Responded mean in Expert Advice?
answer: Responded means the clinician has replied to your query. Go to the Expert Advice Desk and open your query to read the response. You may also receive a notification by SMS or email.

question: What does Closed mean in Expert Advice?
answer: Closed means the query has been fully resolved and no further action is needed. You can still view the conversation history for your records.

question: Can I attach a file to my query?
answer: Yes. When submitting a query through the Expert Advice Desk, you can attach supporting files such as a referral note, a letter from your doctor, or any other relevant document.

question: Can I link my question to a specific video?
answer: Yes. When creating your query in the Expert Advice Desk, you will see an option to link it to a specific video submission. This helps the clinician understand the context of your question.

question: Is the advice from clinicians a medical diagnosis?
answer: No. The advice provided through the Expert Advice Desk is for guidance and informational purposes only. It is not a medical diagnosis. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional in person for any medical concerns about your baby. DISCLAIMER: This platform is non-diagnostic.

question: Can a clinician see my baby's video when I submit a query?
answer: Only if you have granted them access through the Consent and Sharing settings, or if you have linked the video to your query. The clinician will not have access to any data you have not authorised.

question: Is there a community space for caregivers?
answer: Yes. The platform has a moderated community space where registered caregivers and parents can share experiences, ask questions, and interact with each other. You can create posts, read others' posts, and leave comments or reactions.

question: How do I create a post in the community?
answer: Go to the Community section in the app and tap Create Post. Write your question or experience and tap Submit. Your post will be visible to other registered caregivers in the community after moderation.

question: Is the community moderated?
answer: Yes. The community space is moderated to ensure it remains safe, supportive, and appropriate for all caregivers. Posts that violate community guidelines may be removed by moderators.

question: Can I comment on other people's posts?
answer: Yes. You can read other caregivers' posts and leave comments or reactions. This helps build a supportive community where caregivers can share experiences and learn from each other.

question: Is the community space only for registered users?
answer: Yes. Only registered parents and caregivers can access and participate in the community space. You must have a verified account to create posts, comment, or react.

question: How is my baby's data protected?
answer: Your baby's data is stored securely and is only accessible to people you have given consent to. The platform uses strict access controls and all data access is logged in an audit trail. You can manage your privacy settings at any time.

question: Can I request my data to be deleted?
answer: Yes. You can submit a data deletion request through the Privacy and Data section of the app. An administrator will review your request and process it. Some data may be retained for legal or audit purposes as required by data retention rules.

question: What is the audit log?
answer: The audit log is a secure record of who accessed which video or report, what action they performed, and when. This is only visible to authorised administrators and ensures accountability for all data access on the platform.

question: How long is my data kept?
answer: Data is kept according to the platform's data retention policy, which follows legal and clinical guidelines. If you request deletion, the platform will process your request while ensuring compliance with retention rules. Contact your care team or administrator for specific timeframes.

question: Who can access my baby's data?
answer: Only people you have explicitly authorised can access your baby's data. This may include assessors, clinicians, or doctors you have granted access to. You can view and manage this list in the Consent and Sharing settings at any time.

question: What is a follow-up task?
answer: A follow-up task is an action set by a clinician or assessor for your baby's ongoing care. Examples include scheduling the next assessment date or visiting a clinic. You will be notified when a follow-up task is assigned to your baby.

question: How will I know if a follow-up is needed?
answer: You will receive a notification by SMS or email when a follow-up task is set for your baby. You can also check the Follow-up section in your baby's profile to see any pending tasks.

question: Can I see upcoming assessment dates?
answer: Yes. Any upcoming assessment dates set by your clinician will be visible in the Follow-up section of your baby's profile. You will also receive a reminder notification before the date.

question: What should I do if I cannot attend a scheduled clinic visit?
answer: Contact your care team as soon as possible to reschedule. Use the contact information provided in the follow-up task or reach out through the Expert Advice Desk. Do not ignore a follow-up appointment as it is important for your baby's care.

question: Who sets the follow-up tasks?
answer: Follow-up tasks are set by the clinician or assessor who reviewed your baby's video. They decide what the next steps are based on their findings and will record the tasks in the system.

question: How do I create a caregiver account?
answer: Download the app and tap Sign Up. Enter your name, email address, and create a password. You will receive a verification email. Once verified, you can log in and start creating baby profiles.

question: I forgot my password. How do I reset it?
answer: On the login screen, tap Forgot Password. Enter your registered email address and you will receive a link to reset your password. Follow the instructions in the email to set a new password.

question: How do I update my contact information?
answer: Go to Account Settings and select Edit Profile. You can update your phone number, email address, and other contact details. Make sure to save changes before leaving the screen.

question: Can I have more than one caregiver on the same baby's profile?
answer: Currently, one account manages one set of baby profiles. If another caregiver needs access, contact your care team or administrator to discuss shared access options available on the platform.

question: How do I log out of the app?
answer: Go to Account Settings and tap Log Out. You will be returned to the login screen. For security, always log out if you are using a shared device.

question: The app is not loading. What should I do?
answer: First, check your internet connection. Try closing the app completely and reopening it. If the problem continues, restart your phone. Make sure your app is updated to the latest version. If none of this helps, contact support through the Help section.

question: The video recording button is not working. What do I do?
answer: Make sure you have given the app permission to access your camera and microphone. Go to your phone settings, find the app, and check that camera permission is enabled. Then try recording again.

question: I cannot log into my account. What should I do?
answer: Check that you are entering the correct email and password. If you have forgotten your password, use the Forgot Password option. If your account has been locked, contact support for help.

question: The app keeps crashing. What should I do?
answer: Try closing all background apps and reopening the app. If the problem continues, uninstall and reinstall the app. Make sure your phone's operating system is up to date. Contact support if the issue persists.

question: I am not receiving SMS notifications even though they are turned on.
answer: Check that the phone number in your account settings is correct. Make sure SMS is not blocked by your phone carrier. Try toggling the SMS notification setting off and back on in the Notification Center. Contact support if the problem continues.

question: My video timeline is empty. Is that normal?
answer: If you have not submitted any videos yet, the timeline will be empty. If you have submitted videos and they are not showing, try refreshing the page or logging out and back in. Contact support if videos are still missing.

question: The upload progress bar is stuck. What should I do?
answer: Check your internet connection. If the connection is weak, the upload may be paused. Move to a stronger signal area and the upload should resume. If the bar stays stuck, close the app and reopen it. The upload should restart from where it stopped.

question: I cannot find the Expert Advice Desk in the app. Where is it?
answer: The Expert Advice Desk is located in the main menu. Look for a section labelled Expert Advice or Ask a Clinician. If you still cannot find it, make sure your app is updated to the latest version.

question: I submitted a query but I cannot see it in the Expert Advice Desk.
answer: Try refreshing the Expert Advice page. If the query still does not appear, log out and log back in. If it is still missing, contact support and provide the time and date you submitted the query.

question: The consent form is not loading. What do I do?
answer: Check your internet connection as the consent form requires a stable connection to load. Try closing and reopening the app. If the problem continues, contact support so they can help you complete the consent process.

question: Is this platform a substitute for seeing a doctor?
answer: No. This platform is not a substitute for seeing a qualified doctor or healthcare professional. It is a support tool to help with remote assessment and monitoring. Always seek medical attention in person for any health concerns about your baby. DISCLAIMER: This platform is non-diagnostic.

question: Can the chatbot give me medical advice?
answer: No. This chatbot cannot give medical advice or diagnose any condition. It can only help you navigate the platform, troubleshoot issues, and understand your video statuses. For medical concerns about your baby, please speak with a qualified healthcare professional. DISCLAIMER: This chatbot is non-diagnostic.

question: My baby seems unwell. What should I do?
answer: If your baby appears unwell or you have any immediate health concerns, please contact your doctor or emergency services right away. Do not rely on this platform for urgent medical decisions. DISCLAIMER: This platform is non-diagnostic and cannot provide emergency medical care.

question: What does non-diagnostic mean?
answer: Non-diagnostic means that the platform and its chatbot do not diagnose any medical conditions. The assessments done by clinicians through the platform are professional observations that are shared with your care team. All medical decisions are made by qualified healthcare professionals, not by this platform.

question: Can I use the review results to self-diagnose my baby?
answer: No. The review results and assessor notes are professional observations intended to be interpreted by your care team. Do not use them to self-diagnose your baby. Always discuss any findings with your doctor or clinician. DISCLAIMER: This platform is non-diagnostic.

question: How far should the camera be from my baby?
answer: The camera should be far enough to show your baby's whole body in the frame. Generally, one to two metres away from the baby works well. Make sure the image is clear and not blurry at that distance.

question: Should I talk to my baby during the recording?
answer: Yes, you can speak gently to keep your baby calm during recording. Just make sure you do not obstruct the camera view of your baby. Your voice can help keep the baby settled during the assessment.

question: Can I stop and restart the recording?
answer: You can stop and restart the recording within the app. If the recording is not good, you can discard it and try again before submitting. Once you submit the video, you cannot take it back unless asked to re-record.

question: What background should I use for the recording?
answer: Use a plain, light-coloured background if possible. Avoid cluttered or busy backgrounds as they can make it harder for the assessor to focus on your baby's movements. A plain mat or clean floor works well.

question: Do I need to record sound in the video?
answer: The video assessment is primarily visual, so sound is not the main focus. However, keeping audio on is fine. The most important thing is that the video is clear and shows your baby's full body and natural movements.

question: What happens after I upload the video?
answer: After uploading, the video status changes to Submitted. An assessor will be assigned to review it. You will receive a notification when the review is complete. In the meantime, you can track the status in your video timeline.

question: Can I upload a video that I recorded earlier on my phone?
answer: Yes, you can upload a previously recorded video from your phone's gallery if the app supports it. However, it is recommended to use the in-app recording feature to ensure the video meets quality requirements before submission.

question: Is there a file size limit for uploads?
answer: The app handles large video files automatically by splitting them into smaller parts for upload. This means even large files can be uploaded reliably. If you encounter an error related to file size, contact support for assistance.

question: Can I track multiple babies' videos at the same time?
answer: Yes. Each baby has their own timeline in the app. You can switch between baby profiles and view the video status and history for each one separately.

question: What should I do when the status says Re-record Needed?
answer: When the status says Re-record Needed, you need to record a new video and upload it. Read any notes provided by the assessor to understand why the previous video was not usable, and address those issues before recording again.

question: What information is required to create a baby profile?
answer: The required information includes your baby's name and date of birth. You can also add optional information such as risk group, contact details, and notes. The more information you provide, the better the care team can support your baby.

question: Can I add more than one contact person to a baby's profile?
answer: Yes, you can add contact information for multiple caregivers or family members in the notes section. For official access management, use the Consent and Sharing settings to grant or restrict access to specific people.

question: What privacy rules do I need to agree to?
answer: The privacy rules explain how your baby's data is collected, stored, and used by the platform. They also describe who can access the data and your rights as a caregiver. You will be shown the full privacy policy before being asked to agree.

question: Do I need to re-consent every time I upload a video?
answer: No. Once you have completed the consent process, it remains in place unless you withdraw it. You will only be asked to re-consent if the privacy policy or terms change significantly, in which case the app will notify you.

question: Can I consent on behalf of my baby?
answer: Yes. As a parent or legal guardian, you provide consent on behalf of your baby. The consent covers the storage and review of your baby's data and videos by the care team.

question: What does the follow-up due notification mean?
answer: A follow-up due notification means that a task set by your clinician is coming up or is overdue. This could be an upcoming assessment date or a recommended clinic visit. Open the app and check your baby's Follow-up section for details.

question: Can I turn off notifications?
answer: Yes. You can manage your notification preferences in the Notification Center. You can turn off specific types of notifications or all notifications. However, it is recommended to keep important notifications on so you do not miss critical updates about your baby's care.

question: I received a notification but there is nothing new in the app. What happened?
answer: Try refreshing the app by closing and reopening it. Sometimes there is a short delay between the notification and the app updating. If the issue persists, log out and back in, or contact support.

question: Can I submit more than one query at a time?
answer: Yes. You can submit multiple queries to the Expert Advice Desk. Each query is tracked separately with its own status. You can view all your queries and their responses in the Expert Advice section.

question: Will the clinician see all my baby's information when I submit a query?
answer: The clinician will only see information you have authorised through the consent and sharing settings. If you link a specific video to your query, the clinician will be able to access that video if they have the appropriate permissions.

question: Can I reply to a clinician's response?
answer: Yes. The Expert Advice Desk supports threaded replies. Once a clinician has responded, you can reply within the same thread to ask follow-up questions or provide additional information.

question: Can I share my baby's videos in the community?
answer: No. Baby videos are private clinical data and cannot be shared in the community space. The community is for sharing experiences, asking general questions, and supporting other caregivers.

question: What kind of posts are not allowed in the community?
answer: Posts that are abusive, inappropriate, contain personal medical data, or violate community guidelines are not allowed. The community is moderated and such posts will be removed. Always be respectful and supportive of other caregivers.

question: Can doctors outside the platform see my baby's data?
answer: No. Only people you have explicitly granted access to through the Consent and Sharing settings can view your baby's data. Doctors or specialists outside the platform cannot access your data unless you give them permission through the app.

question: What is a data retention rule?
answer: Data retention rules are guidelines that determine how long your data is kept on the platform. These rules are based on legal and clinical requirements. Even if you request deletion, some data may be kept for a minimum period to comply with these rules.

question: My notifications are going to spam. What should I do?
answer: Add the platform's email address to your contact list or safe senders list in your email app. This should prevent notifications from being sent to spam. You can find the platform's email address in the app's Help or Contact section.

question: The community section is not loading. What should I do?
answer: Check your internet connection. Try refreshing the community page or closing and reopening the app. If it still does not load, the community may be temporarily under maintenance. Check back later or contact support for more information.

question: I accidentally deleted a baby profile. Can it be restored?
answer: Profile deletion is a sensitive action and may be reversible depending on your platform's data policy. Contact support or an administrator as soon as possible. Provide your account details and the baby's name so they can investigate.

question: The Expert Advice Desk is showing an error. What do I do?
answer: Try refreshing the page or closing and reopening the app. If the error continues, note the error message shown and contact support. Provide the error message details so the support team can investigate.

question: Can I use the front camera of my phone?
answer: It is recommended to use the rear camera of your phone as it provides higher quality video. However, if the front camera is more convenient and provides a clear, full-body view of your baby, it may be acceptable. Follow the app's instructions for camera selection.

question: What should I do if my baby falls asleep during recording?
answer: If your baby falls asleep, stop the recording and try again when the baby is awake and calm. A sleeping baby cannot demonstrate the natural movements needed for assessment.

question: Can I record in a different room each time?
answer: Yes, you can record in different rooms as long as the lighting is good, the background is clear, and the baby is comfortable. The quality of the video matters more than where it is recorded.

question: How do I know if my video has been received by the assessor?
answer: Once your video is submitted and received, the status in your timeline will change to Submitted. You will also receive a notification confirming receipt. If the status does not update after a few hours, contact support.

question: Can I add a photo to my baby's profile?
answer: Check the baby profile editing screen to see if a photo option is available. Adding a photo is optional and does not affect the assessment process.

question: What happens if I do not give consent?
answer: Without consent, the platform cannot review your baby's videos or share data with the care team. The consent process is required to ensure your privacy rights are respected before any data is processed.

question: How do I know what my next steps are after a review?
answer: After a review is complete, you will receive a notification. Open the app and go to your baby's timeline. Tap on the reviewed video to see the assessor's notes and recommended next steps. Follow-up tasks will also appear in the Follow-up section.

question: What if I disagree with a follow-up recommendation?
answer: If you have concerns about a follow-up recommendation, you can submit a query through the Expert Advice Desk to discuss it with a clinician. You should also speak with your doctor or care team in person for further guidance.

question: How do I change my email address?
answer: Go to Account Settings and select Edit Profile. Update your email address and save the changes. You may receive a verification email to confirm the new address. Make sure to verify it so you continue receiving important notifications.

question: Can I delete my caregiver account?
answer: You can request account deletion through the Privacy and Data section. An administrator will process your request. Note that deleting your account will also remove access to all associated baby profiles and data, subject to data retention rules.

question: Is my account information secure?
answer: Yes. Your account is protected with a secure password and the platform uses encryption to protect your data. Always use a strong password and do not share your login details with others.

question: What if I do not have a smartphone?
answer: If you do not have a smartphone, contact your care team. They may be able to arrange an alternative way for you to submit a video, such as using a device at a clinic or community centre.

question: Can I use a video recording app other than the built-in one?
answer: It is recommended to use the in-app recording feature to ensure quality checks are applied before submission. If you record externally, the video may still need to meet quality requirements before being accepted.

question: I got a re-record notification but my video looks fine to me. Why?
answer: Assessors are trained to look for specific clinical details in videos. A video that looks fine to you may not meet the quality standards needed for a proper assessment. Read the assessor's notes for the specific reason and try to address it in the new recording.

question: Is my data shared with third parties?
answer: Your data is not shared with third parties without your consent. The platform only shares data with people you have explicitly authorised through the Consent and Sharing settings. Review the privacy policy for full details on data handling.

question: What kind of questions can I ask in the Expert Advice Desk?
answer: You can ask clinical questions related to your baby's assessment, development observations, or follow-up recommendations. You can also ask for clarification on assessor notes. Remember that responses are for guidance only and are not a medical diagnosis. DISCLAIMER: This platform is non-diagnostic.

question: How many times can I re-submit a video?
answer: There is no strict limit on resubmissions. You can re-record and resubmit as many times as needed until a good quality video is accepted. Follow the assessor's feedback each time to improve the recording.

question: Will I be charged if I submit multiple videos?
answer: The platform's billing and access terms depend on your specific arrangement with your care provider or institution. Contact your care team or administrator for information about costs related to multiple submissions.

question: Can I message other caregivers directly?
answer: The community space currently supports public posts and comments. Direct private messaging between caregivers may not be available. Check the Community section of the app for the latest available features.

question: Can healthcare professionals see the community posts?
answer: Community posts are visible to registered caregivers. Healthcare professionals on the platform may have access depending on their role. The community is moderated but is primarily a peer support space, not a clinical advice channel.

question: I cannot attach a file to my Expert Advice query. What do I do?
answer: Make sure the file is in a supported format such as PDF, JPEG, or PNG. Check that the file size is not too large. If the issue continues, try using a different file format or contact support for help with the attachment.

question: My baby profile is not saving. What should I do?
answer: Make sure all required fields are filled in correctly. Check your internet connection as saving requires a stable connection. Try closing and reopening the app and entering the information again. Contact support if the issue persists.

question: What happens if I miss a follow-up appointment?
answer: If you miss a follow-up appointment, contact your care team as soon as possible to reschedule. Missing appointments may delay your baby's care. You can use the Expert Advice Desk to notify the clinician and arrange a new time.

question: Can I use the same account on multiple devices?
answer: Yes. You can log into your account on multiple devices using your email and password. Your data is synced to the platform so it will be consistent across devices.

question: What time of day is best for recording?
answer: Record when your baby is awake, calm, and alert. This is often after a feed when the baby is content but not sleepy. Avoid recording when the baby is hungry, tired, or unsettled.

question: Should I remove any toys or objects from around the baby?
answer: Yes. Remove any toys or distracting objects from around the baby before recording. This helps the assessor focus on the baby's natural movements without distractions in the frame.

question: What should I do if the app shows an upload error message?
answer: Note the error message shown on screen. Check your internet connection and try again. If the error persists, contact support and share the error message so they can help you resolve the issue.

question: Can I transfer a baby's profile to another caregiver account?
answer: Profile transfers between accounts may require administrator assistance. Contact support or your care team to request this. Provide details of both accounts and the reason for the transfer.

question: How do I know who has access to my baby's data right now?
answer: Go to the Consent and Sharing settings in the app. You will see a list of all people who currently have access to your baby's data. You can remove access for anyone on the list at any time.

question: What happens to my data if I stop using the platform?
answer: Your data remains stored on the platform according to the data retention policy even if you stop using the app. You can request deletion of your data through the Privacy and Data section. Contact your care team for more information on the process.

question: Can I set a preferred time for notifications?
answer: Notification timing is largely determined by system events such as when a review is completed. Check the Notification Center settings to see if quiet hours or delivery preferences are available for your account.

question: Is the Expert Advice Desk available 24 hours a day?
answer: You can submit queries at any time. However, clinicians will respond during their working hours. Response times will vary. You will be notified when a clinician responds to your query.

question: How do I report an inappropriate post in the community?
answer: Tap on the post and look for a Report option. Select the reason for reporting and submit the report. The moderation team will review it and take appropriate action.

question: What does it mean when a video is flagged?
answer: A flagged video means the assessor has identified something in the video that needs further attention or follow-up. You will receive a notification and the assessor's notes will explain the reason for the flag and the recommended next steps.

question: I changed my phone and cannot log in anymore. What do I do?
answer: Your account is linked to your email and password, not your device. Download the app on your new phone and log in using the same email and password. All your data and baby profiles will be accessible once you log in.

question: The app is running slowly. How can I fix this?
answer: Close other apps running in the background on your phone. Check that your phone has enough storage space. Restart your phone and try again. Updating the app to the latest version can also improve performance.

question: What do I do if the app crashes while recording?
answer: If the app crashes during recording, reopen it. The in-progress recording may have been saved as a draft. Check the Draft section of your timeline. If no draft is saved, you will need to record the video again.

question: Can I record the video in portrait or landscape mode?
answer: Follow the app's instructions for orientation. Some assessments may require a specific orientation to ensure the full body is captured correctly. The app will guide you on the correct way to hold your device.

question: What is the notes field used for in the baby profile?
answer: The notes field is for any additional information that may be relevant to your baby's care. This could include medical history, feeding patterns, observations, or anything else you want the care team to know.

question: What do I do if my email address is already registered?
answer: If your email is already registered, you may already have an account. Try logging in with that email and using the Forgot Password option to reset your access. If you still have trouble, contact support.

question: Can I grant access to multiple clinicians at once?
answer: Yes. You can add multiple clinicians or doctors to your access list in the Consent and Sharing settings. Each person will be able to access the data you have authorised for them.

question: Can I add my own notes to a follow-up task?
answer: Follow-up tasks are set by clinicians. If you want to add context or questions, use the Expert Advice Desk to communicate with the clinician directly and discuss the task in more detail.

question: Can I pause the upload and continue later?
answer: Yes. The upload system supports pausing and resuming. If you close the app or lose connection, the upload will be paused and will resume automatically when you reconnect or reopen the app.

question: How do I submit a data deletion request?
answer: Go to the Privacy and Data section in the app settings and select Request Data Deletion. Fill in the required details and submit. An administrator will review your request and contact you with the next steps.

question: I cannot see the Follow-up section in my baby's profile.
answer: The Follow-up section appears once a clinician has assigned a follow-up task to your baby. If no tasks have been set yet, the section may be empty or not visible. Check after your first review is completed.

question: Can I edit or delete my community post?
answer: Check the community post for an Edit or Delete option. Depending on the platform's settings, you may be able to edit or delete your own posts within a certain time window. Contact support if you need help removing a post.

question: What should I do in a medical emergency involving my baby?
answer: Call your local emergency services immediately. Do not use this platform for emergency situations. This platform is designed for non-urgent remote assessment support and cannot provide emergency medical assistance. DISCLAIMER: This platform is non-diagnostic.

question: Can the assessor diagnose my baby through the video?
answer: No. The assessor observes and notes your baby's movements in the video. This is not a medical diagnosis. The observations are shared with your care team to support clinical decision making. Always consult a qualified doctor for any medical decisions. DISCLAIMER: This platform is non-diagnostic.

question: Can I record on behalf of another caregiver?
answer: Yes, as long as you are an authorised caregiver for that baby's profile. Make sure you are logged into the correct account and recording for the correct baby profile before submitting.

question: Can I cancel a video submission?
answer: Once a video is submitted, it cannot be recalled. However, you can contact your care team if there was an error in the submission. If the video has not yet been reviewed, they may be able to assist you.

question: How do I contact support?
answer: Go to the Help section in the app menu. From there you can find the support contact options including email, phone, or in-app chat if available. Describe your issue clearly so the support team can assist you quickly.

question: What happens when a query is closed?
answer: A closed query means the conversation has ended and no further responses are expected. You can still view the full conversation history for your records. If you have a new question, you can submit a new query through the Expert Advice Desk.

question: Will my name be visible to other caregivers in the community?
answer: Your display name or username will be visible when you post or comment in the community. Review your account settings to check or update your display name. Avoid using personal information as your display name for privacy.

question: Can I export my baby's data?
answer: Data export options depend on the platform's features and your care provider's policies. Contact support or your administrator to find out if data export is available for your account.

question: What if the quality check keeps failing even after I try again?
answer: Read the specific reason the quality check is failing in the app. Address each issue carefully before recording again. If you are still struggling, contact support or ask a question through the Expert Advice Desk for guidance on improving your recording technique.

question: What does the video received notification mean?
answer: The video received notification confirms that your uploaded video has been successfully received by the platform and is in the queue for review. No action is needed from you at this point.

question: Can I see the full assessment history of my baby?
answer: Yes. Your baby's video timeline shows all past submissions, statuses, and assessor notes. You can scroll through the history to review all previous assessments.

question: Will I be reminded about follow-up tasks automatically?
answer: Yes. The system will send you automatic reminders for upcoming follow-up tasks by SMS or email, depending on your notification preferences. Make sure your contact details are up to date to receive these reminders.

question: Can I see what data has been collected about my baby?
answer: Yes. You can view the data collected and stored about your baby through the Privacy and Data section of the app. This includes videos submitted, profile information, and assessment records you are authorised to view.

question: The timeline is showing videos in the wrong order. Is that normal?
answer: Videos are usually shown in chronological order. If the order looks incorrect, try refreshing the timeline. If the issue persists, contact support and describe the issue so they can investigate.

question: What should I do if I think my account has been hacked?
answer: Change your password immediately through Account Settings. If you cannot log in, use the Forgot Password option. Contact support right away and report the suspected security breach so they can investigate and secure your account.

question: What is the minimum age for a baby to be assessed through the platform?
answer: The platform is designed to support assessment from early infancy. Your care team will advise you on when your baby should be recorded based on their clinical situation. Follow your doctor's guidance on assessment timing.

question: What is the purpose of the audit log?
answer: The audit log records all access and actions performed on videos and reports, including who viewed or downloaded them. It is used to ensure accountability and protect your data. Only authorised administrators can see the audit log.

question: Can I follow other caregivers in the community?
answer: Community following or friend features depend on the platform's current capabilities. Check the Community section for available social features. The primary purpose of the community is peer support through posts and comments.

question: Can I rate or give feedback on a clinician's response?
answer: Feedback options may be available after a query is closed. Check the Expert Advice Desk for a feedback or rating option. Your feedback helps improve the quality of the service provided through the platform.

question: Can I see the assessor's notes in the app?
answer: Yes. Once a review is complete, you can tap on the reviewed video in your timeline to see the assessor's notes and any recommended next steps that have been shared with you.

question: The consent form is not accepting my signature. What do I do?
answer: Make sure you are following the on-screen instructions for signing. Try using your fingertip if using a touchscreen. If the issue continues, try on a different device or contact support for an alternative way to complete the consent process.

question: I cannot open the screening report. What should I do?
answer: Make sure you have a PDF viewer installed on your device. Try downloading the report and opening it with a PDF app. If the report does not download, check your internet connection and try again. Contact support if the problem persists.

question: Can I see follow-up tasks for all my babies in one place?
answer: Follow-up tasks are linked to individual baby profiles. Switch between baby profiles to view the follow-up tasks for each one. Check if the app has a combined dashboard view by exploring the home screen or menu options.

question: Can I record a video if I am not at home?
answer: Yes. You can record anywhere as long as you have a quiet, well-lit space with a clear background and a stable surface for your baby. Make sure you have a good internet connection available to upload the video afterward.

question: What if the chatbot gives me incorrect information?
answer: This chatbot provides guidance based on a predefined knowledge base. If you believe information is incorrect or you have a medical concern, always verify with your doctor or care team. DISCLAIMER: This chatbot is non-diagnostic and is not a substitute for professional medical advice.

question: Is there a mobile app or only a web version?
answer: The platform is available as a mobile app for easy access on smartphones. Check the app store for your device to download it. A web version may also be available depending on your care provider's setup.

question: How do I update my phone number for SMS notifications?
answer: Go to Account Settings and update your phone number in the contact information section. Save the changes. Future SMS notifications will be sent to the updated number.

question: Will my data be used for research?
answer: Data usage for research is covered in the privacy policy. The platform will only use your data for research purposes if you have given specific consent for this. Review the privacy policy and your consent settings for details.

question: How do I leave the community?
answer: You can stop participating in the community at any time simply by not posting or commenting. If you want to fully opt out, check the community settings or contact support to see if there is an option to deactivate community access.

question: What should I do if I am worried about my baby's development?
answer: If you have concerns about your baby's development, contact your doctor, midwife, or health visitor directly. You can also use the Expert Advice Desk to submit a query to a clinician. Do not rely solely on this platform for developmental concerns. DISCLAIMER: This platform is non-diagnostic and is not a substitute for in-person medical care.
